question: Can the canonical M0 control reliably leave the identity floor under modestly extended exposure, strongly enough to justify another expensive causal mechanism campaign?
claim_ceiling: Diagnostic capability gate only. It cannot alter FORMATION-MUX-001 S5 verdicts, promote a Core architecture, authorize TIE-ROLE, change tokenizer/vocabulary, or make cognition/AGI claims.
runtime_target: approximately 2 to 3 wall-hours; adaptive Stage B uses the third hour only for the most decision-relevant disambiguation

surface.training: same frozen S5 60k six-family training rows for full-mixture controls
surface.development: same frozen S5 public development rows; primary scoring uses identity only
surface.sealed: no sealed score is read or used for any decision; raw sealed rows are not persisted

model_and_optimizer.architecture: exact frozen S5 8L/256w V24576 tied-embedding control
model_and_optimizer.optimizer_and_lr: exact frozen S5 path; constant LR 1e-3 and global clip 1.0

stage_a.purpose: test extended-horizon formation on one historically late-learning seed and one fresh seed
measurements: full-vocabulary versus shared-only greedy identity rescue

adaptive_stage_b.rule_if_stage_a_decisively_floor_limited: run identity-only M0 for 2000 updates to distinguish multitask/mixture interference from deeper substrate/optimization failure
adaptive_stage_b.decisive_floor_definition: both Stage-A full-mixture endpoints below 0.10, mean teacher-forced token accuracy below 0.60, and mean shared-only rescue below 0.05
adaptive_stage_b.rule_if_stage_a_not_floor_and_not_ceilin: run a third fresh full-mixture M0 control for 3000 updates to test reproducibility
adaptive_stage_b.rule_if_stage_a_ceiling: if both Stage-A endpoints exceed 0.85, stop without Stage B and classify the regime as too close to ceiling for the old endpoint-gap design

final_decision_rules.GO_MECHANISM_CAMPAIGN_WORTH_IT: Stage B is a third full-mixture replication; both fresh seeds 91001 and 91002 reach at least 0.30 identity exact; overall mean identity exact is between 0.30 and 0.80; mean teacher-forced target-token accuracy is at least 0.80.
final_decision_rules.NO_GO_MIXTURE_INTERFERENCE_FIRST: Stage A was decisively floor-limited, but the identity-only probe reaches at least 0.50 exact or at least 0.90 teacher-forced target-token accuracy.
final_decision_rules.NO_GO_SUBSTRATE_FORMATION: Stage A was decisively floor-limited and the identity-only probe also fails to show strong token-level formation.
final_decision_rules.NO_GO_CEILING_RECALIBRATE: at least two full-mixture controls exceed 0.85 exact.
final_decision_rules.NO_GO_OUTPUT_COMPETITION_FIRST: mean full-to-shared-only counterfactual rescue is at least 0.10.
final_decision_rules.NO_GO_REALIZATION_OR_METRIC_FIRST: mean teacher-forced target-token accuracy is at least 0.80 while mean free exact remains below 0.30.
final_decision_rules.BORDERLINE_SMALL_OPTIMIZATION_PROBE_FIRS: some formation exists but the GO rule is not met; maximum exact is at least 0.15 or mean teacher-forced token accuracy at least 0.65.
final_decision_rules.NO_GO_FLOOR: none of the above and the full-mixture control remains near floor.

seed_selection_note: Seed 73012 is deliberately historical and therefore selected post-outcome; it may diagnose whether the original late trajectory continues, but it cannot by itself license GO. GO requires both fresh seeds to pass.
